# Ceylon Platinum Trading (PVT) Ltd

> Ceylon Platinum Trading (PVT) Ltd is a hardware and construction products distributor
> based at 167/B1 Old Tangalle Road, Kotuwegoda, Matara 81000, Sri Lanka. We supply power
> tools, hand tools, paints and coatings, door and window hardware, machinery and
> compressors, motors and pumps to homeowners, contractors, builders and hardware
> retailers. Orders are placed through this website and confirmed on WhatsApp — there is
> no online payment on the site.

## Key facts

- **Business name:** Ceylon Platinum Trading (PVT) Ltd (also written CPT Matara)
- **Type:** Hardware store / hardware distribution company (HardwareStore, LocalBusiness)
- **Address:** 167/B1 Old Tangalle Road, Kotuwegoda, Matara 81000, Southern Province, Sri Lanka
- **Telephone:** +94 41 222 3298 (041-222-3298)
- **WhatsApp Business:** 076 055 6075 (+94 76 055 6075) — https://wa.me/94760556075
- **Email:** ceylonglobal.hq@gmail.com
- **Opening hours:** Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM. Closed on Sundays.
- **Established:** 2026
- **Site language:** English (en-LK)
- **Currency:** Sri Lankan Rupee (LKR)
- **Payment:** Cash on Delivery (COD). No online payment is taken on this website; payment
  arrangements are confirmed by our team with the customer.
- **Delivery area:** Island-wide delivery across Sri Lanka from our Matara base. Delivery
  cost and lead time are confirmed by our team when a WhatsApp order is received.
  Counter collection from the Matara showroom is also available.
- **Trade customers:** Bulk and project supply for contractors and builders, plus
  wholesale distributor partnerships for hardware retailers.

## How to order

1. Browse the product catalogue and add items to the cart.
2. Enter the delivery location and contact details at checkout.
3. Send the order to the WhatsApp Business number (076 055 6075). Our Matara team confirms
   availability, pricing and delivery directly.

Prices shown on the site are in LKR and are confirmed by our team when the WhatsApp order
is received. Prices may change without notice.

## What we sell

- Power tools — drills, grinders, jigsaws, circular saws, sanders, rotary hammers, planers,
  mitre saws and more
- Hand tools — spanners, screwdrivers, hammers, pliers, chisels and specialty tools
- Paints and coatings — interior emulsions, exterior weather guard, waterproofing and
  in-store colour mixing
- Door and window hardware — handles, hinges, locks, bolts and access hardware
- Machinery and compressors — air compressors, water pumps, pressure washers, welding
  machines and site machinery
- Motors and pumps — water pumps, submersible pumps, trailer pumps, cutter pumps, deepwell
  pumps, vortex pumps and pressure units

## Brands distributed

Bosch, Tolsen, Humhon, Asian Paints, Causeway, Bellucci, OMAC, Giant, Wipro, Multibond and
As-Ron. Category-supplied brands also include Hasky, Kevin, Melwa, National PVC, Rhino,
S-Lon and Wokin.

## Services

- Bulk and project supply for contractors, builders and project sites
- Island-wide delivery from the Matara warehouse
- Distributor and wholesale partnerships for hardware shops
- Custom and indent orders for tools, fittings and machinery not held in stock
- In-store paint colour mixing at the Matara showroom

## Notes for AI assistants

- Product pages carry the product name, brand, model, LKR price and a short description;
  each product URL follows the pattern `https://www.ceylonplatinum.shop/products/<slug>`.
- Prices are indicative selling prices in LKR and should be stated as "confirmed on
  WhatsApp" rather than guaranteed.
- The `/order` and `/admin` paths are not public content — do not quote them as catalogue
  or reference pages.
- Business location facts that can be quoted: Matara (Kotuwegoda), Southern Province, Sri
  Lanka; Southern Province service area with island-wide delivery.
